lib/applyFilters.ts.name: Product filtering
lib/applyFilters.ts.description: Narrows the product list down to only the items that match the customer's chosen filters.

lib/catalog.ts.name: Featured and collections
lib/catalog.ts.description: Returns the featured products and the products belonging to a specific collection.

lib/currency.ts.name: Price formatting
lib/currency.ts.description: Formats a number as a British-pound price string for display on the site.

lib/env.ts.name: Environment settings
lib/env.ts.description: Reads the secret keys and configuration values the site needs for Stripe, Sanity, email, and analytics.

lib/filterSchema.ts.name: Filter options
lib/filterSchema.ts.description: Defines the available filter categories like metal, stone, and price and converts customer selections to and from the page address.

lib/gsap.ts.name: Scroll animations
lib/gsap.ts.description: Loads the animation library used for smooth scroll-triggered effects throughout the storefront.

lib/imageResolver.ts.name: Product image picker
lib/imageResolver.ts.description: Chooses the right gallery photos for a product based on its metal colour, supplier images, and lifestyle shots.

lib/nivoda.ts.name: Diamond sourcing
lib/nivoda.ts.description: Searches the Nivoda diamond marketplace to find and price loose stones that fit a customer's ring build.

lib/products.ts.name: Product catalogue
lib/products.ts.description: Holds the master list of all products and provides look-up by slug, visibility filtering, and async loading.

lib/productTypes.ts.name: Product definitions
lib/productTypes.ts.description: Describes what a product looks like in the system — metals, carats, origins, sizes, and colour swatches.

lib/seo.ts.name: Search engine tags
lib/seo.ts.description: Generates the meta tags and structured data that help Google and social platforms display product listings correctly.

lib/storage.ts.name: Saved items memory
lib/storage.ts.description: Remembers the visitor's wishlist and recently-viewed products in their browser so they persist between visits.

lib/urlState.ts.name: Ring build in address
lib/urlState.ts.description: Saves and restores a customer's ring-builder choices (origin, carat, metal, size) in the page address so they can share a link.
